title: Vacancy on Broadcasting Standards Authority
content:
4 September 2002

Vacancy on Broadcasting Standards Authority

  • Steve Maharey
Broadcasting

Dr Bronwyn Hayward has resigned from the Broadcasting Standards Authority to pursue a new career opportunity in children's and educational media, Broadcasting Minister Steve Maharey said today.

Dr Hayward, a former chairperson of the Children's Television Foundation, had served one year of a three-year term.

Steve Maharey thanked Dr Hayward for her service and said the process to appoint a new member would begin immediately.
